parsed.result_reading: The robot fails to walk on all 4 seeds (0/4 walking). It falls forward in 3 seeds and backward in 1, with a median fall time of 6.53 s. Key symptomatic measures: pitch mean 0.154 rad (healthy ≤0.115), pitch rate mean 0.14 rad/s (healthy ≤0.0155), capture margin over L mean 0.087 (healthy negative), angular momentum norm mean 0.0091 (healthy ~0.001), slip fraction 0.075 (healthy ≤0.006), friction utilisation p95 =1.0 (healthy ≤0.336), max saturation fraction 0.113 (healthy ≈0), knee saturation 0.113, ankle saturation 0.079, double support fraction 0.059 (healthy ≤0.059), flight fraction 0.0073 (healthy ≤0.0067). Tracking errors are below healthy ranges (hip 0.013 vs healthy 0.038‑0.062, knee 0.024 vs healthy 0.026‑0.047). Torque ratio is 0.171 vs healthy ~0.995, indicating low torque authority. Leg length L=0.379 m is shorter than the reference 0.6 m, while foot length is relatively long (foot_to_leg=0.44 vs reference 0.267). Overall the robot exhibits forward momentum, excessive slip, insufficient corrective torque, and a forward‑biased posture.

Capture margin mean showed no improvement, and angular momentum remained high. Step length over L increased (0.220→0.242) yet the end‑of‑step capture margin became more negative (‑0.211→‑0.237), showing worsening forward instability late in stance. The robot exhibits large forward lean (pitch_mean 0.154 rad, pitch_rate_mean 0.14 rad/s) and high knee saturation (pre_fall knee saturation 0.88), suggesting excessive forward posture drives the COM ahead of the centre of pressure, leading to forward falls.

parsed.result_reading: The counterfactual E2 reduced hip_bias by -0.1R and pitch_ref by -0.1R. This decreased forward lean: pitch_mean dropped from 0.154 to 0.063 rad, pitch_rate_mean from 0.14 to 0.015 rad/s. Torque saturations at knee and ankle fell markedly (knee from 0.113 to 0.021, ankle from 0.079 to 0.048). COM trajectory improved: com_vx_mean reduced from 0.244 to 0.194 m/s, com_vx_end from 0.412 to 0.231 m/s, and the COM ended less ahead of the CoP (com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_end shifted from +0.085 to -0.024). Capture margin at the end of stance swung from -0.211 to +0.092, indicating the capture point moved inside the support interval late in stance. Angular momentum and its end value dropped (angmom_norm_end from 0.111 to 0.021). One of four seeds achieved continuous walking for the full 10 s (time_upright reached 10.0 s), while the others fell early (median fall time 1.34 s). Overall, reducing forward lean improved stability but did not eliminate falls entirely.
